newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices remained stable in late trading on Thursday as buying interest remained thin, traders said.
They said olein was generally quoted at 1,450-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but offers were also heard at 1,445 rupiah/kg. No crude palm oil deals were heard.
Traders said the state logistics agency BULOG continued its market operations to keep a lid on prices, selling olein directly to consumers at 1,300 rupiah/litre.
"The market intervention has not had much impact because Bulog is gradually selling olein to the market in small quantities," one trader in Medan said.
The market operations was aimed at ensuring local prices do not rise during the Moslem Ramadan fasting month which begins on Friday.
